forecasts.question: Will Iran publicly commit to resuming mediated ceasefire negotiations (a named Iranian official or MFA announces readiness for talks) before EOD 2026-09-06?
forecasts.delta_reason: RESOLVED-NO. Horizon date Sep 6 passed. No evidence of Iranian official public commitment to talks. Araghchi stated Sep 9 that resuming negotiations is impossible until the US compensates for MOU violations. Active kinetic exchange Sep 1–9 (IRGC BM salvos; CENTCOM tanker strikes) precluded diplomatic space. Resolved Sep 10.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if, before EOD 2026-09-06, a named Iranian official (FM Araghchi, Supreme National Security Council, or IRNA/Tasnim/Press TV quoting an official) issues a public statement committing to resuming or entering mediated ceasefire negotiations with the United States. A 'readiness for talks' declaration counts; mere written-message relay does NOT count.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: One TIER1 (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera) citing the named Iranian official, OR Iranian state media (IRNA/Tasnim) carrying the official statement.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Conditional or preconditioned offers ('will talk if US stops strikes') = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO unless the US publicly accepts the condition; a mediator asserting Iran is 'open' without a named Iranian official statement = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Araghchi or SNSC public statement committing to talks
Oman or Qatar mediator readout citing named Iranian acceptance

forecasts.question: Will a confirmed Iran-US indirect negotiating session (mediated, senior officials, named principals) occur before EOD 2026-09-17?
forecasts.delta_reason: KEEP. No material movement. Araghchi's Sep 9 ruling — negotiations impossible until US compensates MOU violations — was reaffirmed by IRNA on Sep 10. Iran's Sep 1 Pezeshkian statement ('will return to MOU if US does') is a conditional offer categorized AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO under the forecast's own ambiguity rule; it does not constitute movement toward a session. IRGC 10-ship Hormuz attack on Sep 9 further hardened both sides' positions. No mediator readout from Oman/Qatar/Pakistan/Switzerland. Hold at floor.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if a TIER1 source reports a face-to-face or formally convened indirect negotiating session (not mere message relay) between named US and Iranian senior officials/envoys, hosted by a named mediator (Oman/Pakistan/Qatar/Switzerland), between 2026-09-03 and 2026-09-17.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two independent TIER1 OR one TIER1 + official mediator readout.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Message relay through intermediaries without a convened session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Trump assertions of 'semi-negotiating' without Iranian or mediator confirmation of a held session = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Pezeshkian's conditional offer ('if US returns to MOU') without US acceptance = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO.

indicators.name: Oman/Qatar/Pakistan mediator readout of a convened session
Iran MFA confirms re-engagement or talks readiness (unconditional)
US-Iran bilateral halt in strikes for 72h+ (necessary precondition)

forecasts.question: Will commercial shipping through the Strait of Hormuz reach >=30 vessels/day (7-day rolling average) before EOD 2026-10-03?
forecasts.delta_reason: KEEP. No material movement. Hormuz AIS data shows ~6 vessels/day as of Sep 10 — 93% below pre-war normal. Iran attacked 10 commercial and naval vessels near Hormuz on Sep 9 (largest declared wave; UKMTO confirmed multiple hits). IRGC published coordinates of the restricted maritime zone (announced Sep 7 by Secretary Rezaei), extending the Iranian claimed interdiction perimeter beyond the Strait proper into the Gulf of Oman and Arabian Sea. No P&I insurer restatement, no diplomatic halt to mine/attack activity. Hold at floor.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if Windward or MarineTraffic (primary AIS tracker) records >=30 commercial transits/day as a 7-day rolling average at any point between 2026-09-03 and 2026-10-03, confirmed by one TIER1 source (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List).
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Windward or MarineTraffic as primary AIS tracker showing >=30 commercial transits/day (7-day rolling), plus one TIER1 (Bloomberg/Reuters/Lloyd's List Intelligence) confirmation.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Naval escort vessels and warships do not count toward commercial transit. If Windward and MarineTraffic diverge by >20% in their daily count, flag AMBIGUOUS and await reconciliation before resolving. Any IRGC-attributed vessel attack within the resolution window that disrupts AIS tracking extends the AMBIGUOUS flag one additional day.

indicators.name: Windward/MarineTraffic 7-day rolling average reaches >=15 vessels/day (interim threshold)

forecasts.question: Will Iran conduct a confirmed ballistic missile or drone strike against a US military asset or GCC partner territory before EOD 2026-09-13?
forecasts.delta_reason: UPDATE (+7pp). Iran attacked 10 vessels near the Strait of Hormuz on Sep 9 — the largest declared wave of the conflict (Foreign Policy, UKMTO). The IRGC published restricted-zone coordinates on Sep 9, extending claimed interdiction authority beyond Hormuz. The tit-for-tat cadence (CENTCOM 5 tankers Sep 8 → IRGC 10-ship attack Sep 9) places another IRGC kinetic response against a US or GCC target within the Sep 10–13 window with high plausibility. A CBS report cited overnight aircraft damage at Jordan's Muwaffaq Salti AB on Sep 9–10; CENTCOM has not confirmed attribution — this alone does not meet the resolution threshold but raises the cadence-continuity estimate to 0.72.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if CENTCOM or a GCC partner government confirms an Iranian ballistic missile or UAV strike against a US military facility or GCC partner military territory between 2026-09-10 00:00 UTC and 2026-09-13 23:59 UTC. Houthi attacks do not count unless CENTCOM explicitly attributes direct Iranian command-and-control.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: CENTCOM official statement plus at least one TIER1 source (Reuters/AP/AFP/Al Jazeera).
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If attribution is disputed by both Iran and CENTCOM, or if the strike hits only civilian infrastructure without CENTCOM acknowledging the attack: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO pending further confirmation within 24h of the resolution deadline. CBS-only reporting without CENTCOM confirmation = AMBIGUOUS.

indicators.name: IRGC state media threat language elevated ('response imminent' or equivalent)
US NOTAM issued restricting Gulf airspace (precautionary posture)
CENTCOM or GCC partner confirms strike damage at US/GCC military facility
indicators.expected_effect: +50pp toward YES — direct resolution trigger if confirmed

forecasts.question: Will ICE Brent front-month crude settle above $100.00/barrel on three consecutive trading days before EOD 2026-09-17?

Brent reported at $101.25–$104.41/bbl on Sep 10 across Trading Economics, Energy Intelligence, and Convex sources; Sep 11 at $102.59 (Trading Economics). Two trading days strongly above $100 are consistent with settlement breach, though official ICE settlement for Sep 10 has not been confirmed in a single authoritative Bloomberg/Reuters print — DA flagged this ambiguity; Judge reduces from Analyst 0.82 to 0.72. The Houthi seizure of Mocha (Sep 10–11) and advance toward Bab el-Mandeb adds a second structural supply-disruption threat: if Houthis establish Red Sea fire control, market pricing for a second global chokepoint closure would sustain $100+ through the Sep 17 window. Need one more confirmed ICE settlement above $100 before Sep 17.
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if ICE Brent front-month official settlement price exceeds $100.00/barrel on any three trading days (not necessarily consecutive by calendar; any three within the window 2026-09-10 to 2026-09-17) as reported by Bloomberg or Reuters.

forecasts.ambiguity_rule: If ICE suspends trading due to force majeure or regulatory halt: AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO for that day and extend window by one trading day. Intraday prints do not count; only official end-of-day settlement.

forecasts.question: Will Houthi forces establish confirmed fire control over the Bab el-Mandeb Strait (presence confirmed at or south of Dhubab, or seizure of Perim Island) before EOD 2026-09-20?
forecasts.delta_reason: New 9-day forecast. Houthi forces seized Mocha on Sep 10 (Times of Israel, Euronews, Foreign Policy, Cyprus Mail) and advanced down the Red Sea coast toward the Hanish Islands. Yemeni government forces relocated south toward Dhubab — the town directly on the Bab el-Mandeb Strait. UNSC convened an emergency session on Yemen Sep 10. Houthi spokesman confirmed the advance was coordinated with Iran's broader campaign. Dhubab is approximately 120km from Mocha by road; Hanish Islands (currently Houthi-adjacent) are 70km north of the strait entrance. The 9-day window is tight given organized resistance at Dhubab and logistical friction, but Houthi advances in this phase of the conflict have been faster than historical civil-war pace. P=0.20 (Judge compromise: DA recommended 0.15 citing slow historical Mocha-to-strait timeline; Analyst proposed 0.22; Judge sets 0.20 acknowledging better Houthi capability in 2026 vs prior civil-war periods).
forecasts.resolution_criteria: YES if two TIER1 sources (Reuters/AFP/AP) report Houthi forces have established military presence at or south of Dhubab (directly on the strait) OR seized Perim Island, before EOD 2026-09-20. CENTCOM acknowledgment of Houthi Bab el-Mandeb chokepoint control also resolves YES.
forecasts.resolution_source_rule: Two TIER1 (Reuters/AFP/AP/Bloomberg) independently reporting Houthi control at Dhubab/Perim OR one CENTCOM official statement acknowledging Houthi control of the chokepoint.
forecasts.ambiguity_rule: Houthi forces reaching Dhubab area but not establishing military presence (e.g. passing through, not holding) = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. UNSC statements or analyst assessments without confirmed troop presence on the strait = AMBIGUOUS-RESOLVE-AS-NO. Houthi claim without TIER1 confirmation = AMBIGUOUS.

indicators.name: Houthi forces confirmed at Dhubab (<=5km from Bab el-Mandeb strait entrance)
indicators.expected_effect: +40pp toward YES if confirmed by Reuters/AFP
